messages.author: 132678befc181647
messages.subject: Retaining Rqtl text output
parts: R/qtl users:  I have been running text batchfiles of R/qtl commands overnight on my laptop, but in some cases of extensive text output (lists mainly), the early part of the R/qtl R batchfile output text is not retained (apparently it has scrolled off the end of the top of the record of console text).  Is there any way to increase the amount of text output retained in the R console so that I can recover it in the morning?  - Jim

messages.author: 963b6d84a823404f
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Retaining Rqtl text output
parts:
It would be best to run R from the command line, using R CMD BATCH (see http://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-patched/library/utils/html/BATCH.html). For example:

R CMD BATCH my_input.R the_output.txt

Then the_output.txt should contain absolutely everything.

Also, I would generally save the important results to files, using code like

save(object, file="object.RData")

karl
